content.comment_body: I need introductory information about [product_name] [version_no] since this is my first time using it. Our setup includes one [product_name] [version_no] controller in each of 13 buildings, totaling 13 controllers. The system has 52 digital outputs and 5 digital inputs, with each controller handling 4 outputs. My questions are: 1. Is it possible to connect all 13 controllers for communication, and what is the maximum number allowed on a single network? 2. Can remote I/Os be used instead of installing a controller in each building and linking everything to one main controller through Ethernet?

Hello, With [product_name] modular basic variants, the hardware is designed to support certain networking limits. For the [product_name] [version_no] logic modules, a maximum of 9 devices can be networked together.

A [product_name] [article_no] controller supports up to 24 digital inputs, 20 digital outputs, 8 analog inputs, and 8 analog outputs. There is a limit of 8 static and 16 dynamic connections per controller. For further details, refer to the [document].
With the 8 static connection limit, it means connecting all 13 controllers on a single network is not feasible. You may want to consider switching to a [product_name] [version_no] with remote I/Os.

Could you please provide more information on dynamic connections? Will it be possible to configure dynamic connections within the [product_name] software? What are potential drawbacks of using dynamic connections? Thank you.
Hello, You might find it useful to review the post by [user_name]: TSAP connections? [product_name] - OPC - [company_name] Industry Online Support

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unfamiliar with [product_name] [version_no] controllers and is looking for basic information on networking capabilities and remote I/O alternatives. Responses clarified that network connections are limited, preventing all 13 controllers from being linked together. Discussions on static and dynamic connection limits prompted the user to request more detail on configuration and drawbacks, revealing that documentation could be more explicit and that product scalability is limited.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to reliably network 13 [product_name] [version_no] controllers and wants clear guidance on network limitations and options for remote I/O integration. They also anticipate being able to configure connections via software, particularly dynamic connections.
